latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of AI Video Editor InShot — fast, cloud-based mobile video edits by text.

- Upload 60-second smartphone clips, describe your edits, and get 1080p MP4/video outputs in under a minute.
- Supports trimming, music, transitions, text overlays, and social platform formats (Reels, TikTok).
- Automatic backend connection with credit/token management and status updates.
- Handles multiple file formats (mp4, mov, avi, webm, jpg, png, gif, mp3, etc.), up to 500MB per file.
- Guides users step-by-step without exposing technical details; error and state handling included.
